decisions.reason: Although no longer visible on the website, the modular waste-to-energy extensions still fit the firm's engineering-centered core business and are plausible to continue as customized modules rather than a prominently marketed standalone line.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant remains closely aligned with the firm's flagship sustainability and energy-conversion direction, so it is more likely to be retained despite reduced public visibility and long industrial sales cycles.

Given its weaker website presence after launch and the higher commercialization and scaling risk of plastic-waste-to-fuel solutions, management would likely reallocate resources from this line to stronger core and new development projects.
